items.name: Barberton Mini 4 2024
items.information: This competition is taking place on a **Monday** night! Given the nature of the competition everyone **WILL** be expected to help out with judging, running, and scrambling. If you have any questions please ask before registering. Due to the size of the meeting room **PLEASE** limit the number of guests to 1 if possible. If time permits we will add a final round to 5x5.
